The '''CL69 Landspeeder''' was a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] model produced by [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian Industries]], and was still in existence in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]<ref name="Raid" /> by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="Date" /> The CL69 could travel up to 330 [[Kilometer per hour/Legends|kilometers per hour]]. A CL69 Landspeeder was used by a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] cell on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]]<ref name="Raid" /> in 0 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]].<ref name="Date" /> It aided a group of Alliance [[Privateer/Legends|privateers]] from the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] ''[[Far Orbit]]'', though an Alliance [[Unidentified Rebel waiter|contact]] [[Death/Legends|died]] along the way to [[Mission to Brentaal IV|escape]] the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|ISB]] [[Agent/Legends|agents]], who were following them.<ref name="Raid" />

==Behind the scenes==
The CL69 Landspeeder first appeared in ''[[Raid on Brentaal]]'', an adventure scenario in [[1998]]'s ''[[The Far Orbit Project]]'', by [[Timothy S. O'Brien]]. The book was a supplement to [[West End Games]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' and had the same theme of<ref name="Raid" /> the previous publication ''[[Pirates & Privateers]]'', as it followed the privateering vessel ''Far Orbit''.<ref name="PP">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref>
